Ava (Finance): FYI AtlasNova renewal invoice INV-99920 has errors. Platform fee billed full year after mid-term support downgrade; legacy credit LC-401 still applied.
Liam (Acct): Pulling INV-99920 now.
ops-billing-bot: invoice INV-99920 generated 2026-03-09T07:11:00Z. items: platform_fee $60,000, support $15,000, credits -4800 LC-401.
Raj (Sales): Confirmed amendment AMND-221 and PO-4670 — support tier changed 2026-02-10. Contract calls for pro-rata billing.
Elena (CS): CS confirms LC-401 was consumed on 2025-11-15; evidence in ticket attached.
Liam (Acct): Quick calc: annual 60k -> monthly 5k. Remaining 10.75 months -> 53,750. Overcharge 6,250. With wrong -4,800 credit, net adjustment = 1,450 credit to customer.
Maya (Finance Ops): Ops can approve up to $10k. Approving $1,450.
Liam (Acct): Voided INV-99920 and created INV-99977 with platform_fee_prorated 53,750, support_prorated 13,437.50, no LC-401. Credit memo CM-2026-050 for $1,450 created.
ops-billing-bot: INV-99920 voided by Liam at 2026-03-09T07:42:10Z. INV-99977 created.
Raj (Sales): Notified AtlasNova; they want credit applied to next invoice.
Ava (Finance): Please attach amendment AMND-221, PO-4670, and CS evidence to CM. Maya, please add a billing rule test for mid-term tier proration.
Maya (Finance Ops): Will do (PR #5640). Closing on my side.
Ava (Finance): Thanks — marking FIN-7922 resolved.
